about: Held-out questions (made by make.py from its own data): for measuring only, never for tuning.

questions.question: Which branch in data/loans.csv lent the most books, and how many loans did it make?
On average, how many days did children keep Fantasy books, according to data/loans.csv?
How much did the Harbour branch collect in late fees (data/loans.csv), and what percentage of all late fees is that?
How many loans in data/loans.csv were kept longer than 21 days?
Which city in data/weather.csv had the most rain in May, and how much rain was that?
What was the highest maximum temperature in Bergen in April (data/weather.csv), and on which date was it?
Over the two months in data/weather.csv, how much more rain fell in Bergen than in Oslo?
What is the total value of the stock (quantity times unit cost) in the North warehouse, in data/stock.csv?
Which items in data/stock.csv have fewer than 10 units in a warehouse?
According to docs/handbook.md, how many days of annual leave a year does someone get who has worked here for 4 years?
Using docs/handbook.md, what is the most someone can claim for meals and hotel nights on a 3-night trip to a capital city, with meals for 3 days?
What does docs/handbook.md say about parental leave?
In docs/minutes-2026-03-12.md, who has to book the venue, and by when?
How much of the open day budget in docs/minutes-2026-03-12.md has not been spent yet?
What do the contracts in the contracts folder cost per month altogether?
Which contract in the contracts folder ends first, and on what date?
How many .txt files are in the contracts folder, and which one is the largest?
In config/app.json, what is the payments service's timeout in seconds?
In src/stock.py, below what stock level does restock order more, and how many weeks of sales does an order cover?
How many ERROR lines from the billing service are in logs/app.log?
When did the auth service restart according to logs/app.log, and why?
According to docs/annual-report.md, what dividend per share did the board approve, and what was the headcount at the end of the year?
In exports/orders.html, what do the orders from Velmont add up to?
A recipe for 4 people needs 300 g of flour. How much flour do I need for 10 people?
If I put 2,500 euros into savings at 3.5% interest a year, added once a year, how much will there be after 4 years?
